stem.text: A student investigated the rate of enzyme activity with increasing substrate concentration. The experiment was repeated with the addition of a reversible non-competitive enzyme inhibitor. A graph was plotted to show the results.
Which graph represents the results of the two experiments?

stem.alt: Key: solid line means without enzyme inhibitor; dashed line means with enzyme inhibitor

A.alt: Graph of rate of enzyme activity against substrate concentration with a solid curve and a dashed curve

B.alt: Graph of rate of enzyme activity against substrate concentration with a solid curve and a dashed curve

C.alt: Graph of rate of enzyme activity against substrate concentration with a solid curve and a dashed curve

D.alt: Graph of rate of enzyme activity against substrate concentration with a solid curve and a dashed curve
